name: Deep Spires
design_intent:
DEEP SPIRES — THE HIGH WIRE #13 (tier 3, spires over the deepest void). Six spire-tops sawtooth between y1080 and y560 over the circuit's DEEPEST void (recovery sky ~1200px), separated by 600px gaps with 460-520px vertical climbs, and one central spring throne up over the middle gap (+520). The purest big-vertical-spread exposure: every neighbour is a committed diagonal boost and a mis-aimed arc falls a very long way. kill_shape = void_is_floor. Signature: the extreme-verticality sawtooth pushed to the deepest drop (stagger_spires is the milder version; the ridges are flat). Feel = 'climb the deep sky pillars on committed diagonal boosts; a whiff drops you forever.'

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP ANALYSIS (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / spring 480; drift ~395 trampoline / ~527 spring MAX; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 600px in ~0.9s @ ~24 fuel; super 2800 clears all). Spires S1(0..480 top1080) S2(1080..1560 top560) S3(2160..2640 top1080) S4(3240..3720 top560) S5(4320..4800 top1080) S6(5400..5880 top620); throne spring x2760..3120 top40:
- GAP S1<->S2<->S3<->S4<->S5<->S6: each = 600px horizontal AND a 460-520px vertical offset (a steep diagonal arc). 600 > 527 (max spring drift) on its own, so NO neighbour is bounce-reachable regardless of tier or offset. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED on every crossing; miss = fall into the deepest void. Verb: FLY. (Rule A.)
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top y40): 520px above the high spires (S2/S4 top560), over the open S3<->S4 gap. Trampoline apex 270 from S4 reaches only y290 -> short; an under-shot drops into the void. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY (+ SUPER). (Rule B, >= 520.)
- RECOVER: low spire bottom 1136 -> bottom blast line 2336 = 1200px of open sky (up to ~1720px under the high spires) -> a fuelled knock is a real-but-hard gamble back to a spire; the deep void makes this the least-forgiving recovery in the circuit. Verb: FLY. (Rule D.)
- No route across or up the arena exists without the jetpack. Vertical AND horizontal distance are the entire level, not scenery.
